messages:
Diego Alvarez: Morning team, Diego here — just started today. Trying to spin up a tiny test infra in ap-southeast1 but get permission denied when creating a KMS key. Also need a new GCP project for the APAC sandbox (redwood-apac-sandbox). Who handles KMS/CMEK and project provisioning?

Samira Khan: Welcome Diego! @diego you'll need the `cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` role on the key ring and `resourcemanager.projectCreator` in the org to create projects. I can grant the KMS role if you tell me the key ring path you tried.

Diego Alvarez: Thanks. I tried creating key ring `apac-keys` under project redwood-apac-sandbox, but project doesn't exist yet. Wanted to create project then key ring. Error: `Permission denied (403) calling resource: cloudresourcemanager.projects.create`.

Samira Khan: Ah—you're missing projectCreator. I'll request project creation for you. @CloudAccessBot can you create a ticket to provision project `redwood-apac-sandbox` with owner set to diego@redwood.ai, billing account 01A2B3-C456D, and enable the KMS, Compute Engine, and Cloud SQL APIs? Include ap-southeast1 as allowed region.

CloudAccessBot: New ticket created: PROJ-2026-9112 — Provision project redwood-apac-sandbox. Requested by diego@redwood.ai. ETA 4 hours (non-urgent).

Liam O'Connor: Heads up Diego: for CMEK you also need iam.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the key (not just the ring) depending on how rotation is configured. For quick tests, we usually give the `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the ring and add service account `gke-sa@redwood-apac-sandbox.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.

Diego Alvarez: Got it. One more ask — I need read access to S3 logs in apac-prod-logs bucket for a demo. Can someone add me to the aws-logs-readers group?

Samira Khan: I can add you. Which AWS account number?

Diego Alvarez: 999888777666

infra-bot: Access change queued: add user diego@redwood.ai to group aws-logs-readers in account 999888777666. Approval not required for group 'aws-logs-readers'.

Samira Khan: Done — you have been added. Try `aws s3 ls s3://apac-prod-logs/ --profile redwood` and let us know if you still get AccessDenied.

Diego Alvarez: Listing works! :tada: Back to GCP — any way to expedite the project creation? Demo later today.

Liam O'Connor: I can escalate PROJ-2026-9112 to high priority. Samira, ping me when you confirm billing. If billing account is set and org policy checks pass, we can usually get it in ~1 hour.

Samira Khan: Billing account 01A2B3-C456D is active for APAC. Escalating now.

CloudAccessBot: PROJ-2026-9112 status updated: escalated to high priority by Liam O'Connor.
